outcome.technical: _machine_paths: new _known_roots/_root_alternative/_root_pattern/_rooted. The checkout root, its parent, HOME/USERPROFILE, TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP, expanduser('~') and gettempdir(), each as given and as realpath, are matched as LITERAL prefixes, longest first, before the token grammar runs, in both redacted_free_text and redacted_paths. A posix root takes only '/' and never matches behind a drive letter. An in-checkout match becomes repo-relative, unless it is glued to a preceding path character (a PATH list entry) or leaves the checkout through '..', in which case it becomes the outside token. Under an outside root, a following space-separated word that carries a separator is consumed as the path's tail. scrubbed_values threads `known` through the walk. stamp-verification: child_env reads option strings through _option_words: node's NODE_OPTIONS grammar (double quotes group, a backslash escapes inside them), plus shlex for other variables, then a split on '=' and the path-list separator. The vitest/node 'imported from' importer now runs to end of line. _harness fr2/sr5 read lines rather than whitespace words. sweep-selftests: SPACED_EXEMPT is now {}, sweep() takes exempt=, sp4 uses its own table, new sp6. gate-parity: the SPACED_EXEMPT AUDITED_EXEMPTIONS row is removed (an empty table is not derived). test__manifest_io _CORPUS_REWRITES records the new rewrites, P123.json /tasks/30/redFirst/basis and P124.json /tasks/3/{intentCheck/redFirstBasis,redFirst/basis}: committed /private/var/folders throwaway paths that this machine's temp root now scrubs. check-committed-pii gains q2s (a spaced home path is detected, and the scrub leaves no fragment and no finding). PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE describes both rules. Reds seen before the fix: mp12 (test__machine_paths, plain run, 12/13); sr44 and sr44a (test_stamp_verification --stage sr-budget, 4/6); sm1 (--stage sm-missing-module, importer under 'the tree'); sp4/sp6 (sweep --selftest raised TypeError: sweep() got an unexpected keyword argument 'exempt'). q2s was written after the scrub's literal pass and seen red against the first version of the fix: the tail 'Projects/proj/notes.md' was left beside the token. fr2/sr5 were seen red only under the spaced leg, before the edit. Final: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py` exit 0 (331/331 files, 15645 cases); `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py --spaced` exit 0 (331/331, no exemption); `python3 tools/check-committed-pii.py` exit 0; `python3 tools/gate-parity.py` exit 0; `ruff check plugins/audit tools` exit 0; vermin exit 0; `python3 tools/bench-hooks.py --gate` exit 0. The guide was edited after the sweeps; test__deps, test__refs and test__output were rerun after it, all pass.
